## Build

The top-level build script is `CMakeLists.txt` at the repository root (`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)`, `project(CALAMARES)`).

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
sudo cmake --install build
```

## Dependencies

`Build-Depends` in `debian/control` lists 31 entries; the first 8 are listed below (see `debian/control` for the complete list):

- `extra-cmake-modules`
- `gettext`
- `libkf6config-dev`
- `libkf6coreaddons-dev`
- `libkf6crash-dev`

The top-level `CMakeLists.txt` looks up 8 packages with `find_package`: `Qt5Core`, `Qt6Core`, `YAMLCPP`, `Polkit`, `ECM`, `Python`, `boost_python`, `Boost`.
